hotel.dna:
# Golden Well / U Zlaté Studně — service DNA

## 1. Review status and use

Research checked: 5 October 2026. Public preparation; operator review pending; no hotel operational confirmation. Prices retain their published conditions. Compositions are proposals for staff, not promises or a closed catalogue.

## 2. Identity and service interpretation

A small historic hotel below Prague Castle: 17 rooms and two suites, period furniture, artwork and garden/city views. Restaurant terraces include two outdoors and one indoors. The approach is traffic-free and cobbled. [G01]

Interpretation: room detail, private guiding and destination dining support a personally paced stay. Ask whether history, food, a celebration, work or rest matters most. Do not assign a romantic personality or assume that the approach is accessible to everyone.

## 3. Spaces, teams and working capabilities

| Resource | Published capability | Boundary / owner |
|---|---|---|
| Personalised service | Aromatic bath prepared for return, rose-petal turndown, private guide, in-room therapist massage | Request-based; room suitability, notice and prices unknown [G06] |
| Terasa U Zlaté studně | Tasting menu, wine/alcohol-free pairings, terraces | Restaurant booking, weather and availability [G10, G11] |
| Bohemia lounge | Guest-only 24-hour lounge, tea/coffee | Complimentary wine/refreshments published 16:00–17:30; no private booking implied [G08] |
| Palace Garden Gazebo | Special dining within a premium package | Not general private garden access or all-season availability [G15] |

Published reception: hotel@goldenwell.cz. Dedicated concierge role remains to confirm. Tailored guiding proves coordination capability, not availability of an unnamed guide. [G06, G09]

## 4. Rooms, sleep and practical comfort

A pillow and bedding menu is explicitly published: down/hypoallergenic pillows, duvet or French bedding; four or six pillows are described in the initial setup. Exact firmness/filling options and available quantities remain unknown. [G02]

| Category / resource | Useful detail | Preparation implication |
|---|---|---|
| Superior | 21–25 m², floors 1–3; king/twin and view depend on allocation | Bath/rain shower, Nespresso and tea listed [G03] |
| Deluxe | 24–30 m², floors 1–4; some have sitting area | One extra bed maximum, surcharge [G04] |
| Grand Deluxe | 30–34 m², floors 3–4 | One extra bed maximum; garden/city views [G05] |
| Specific room request | EUR 30/room/stay, subject to availability | Published confirmation-time estimate is not a guaranteed response [G02] |

Room pages describe heated bathroom floors, Molton Brown and opening windows; features vary. Check-in 14:00, checkout 12:00; children up to six free in existing beds; no pets. Extra bed listed EUR 65 plus 12% VAT, with charging period to confirm before calculating a total. [G03–G05, G09]

## 5. Food and drink resources

Current restaurant page identifies chef Lukáš Hlaváček. Menu examples show fish, vegetable, shellfish, meat and pastry expertise: tuna/cucumber/shiso; rabbit/scallop ravioli; halibut/kombu; chocolate/plum/pecan. These are seasonal anchors, not guaranteed stock or individual components available to order. Last tasting order is published as 21:30. [G10]

| Resource | Published price | Conditions |
|---|---|---|
| Tasting menu | CZK 4,100/person | Coffee/mineral water included, gratuity excluded [G10] |
| A5 Wagyu variant | CZK 5,300/person | Current variant, not an entitlement [G10] |
| Wine / premium pairing | CZK 2,900 / 6,900 | Confirm current selection and pours [G10] |
| Alcohol-free wine pairing | CZK 2,500 | Published restaurant option [G10] |
| French Bloom 0.0 blanc/rosé | CZK 390/150 ml; 1,700/bottle | June 2026 list; stock to confirm [G11] |
| Zerrissimo alcohol-free sparkling | CZK 290/150 ml; 1,300/bottle | Separate product/price [G11] |

Czech winemakers on the list include Mádl, Sonberk and Gala: a basis for a sommelier-led local focus, not a priced bespoke pairing. Lounge tea is Ronnefeldt and coffee Nespresso. Room breakfast descriptions mention fresh juice, fruit, bread and cereals, but juice flavours and full breakfast/allergen menus were not established. [G07, G08, G11]

## 6. Wellness, activities and family resources

In-room massage and bath preparation are published; a full spa, pool, sauna or gym is not established. Staff must confirm therapist, oils, fragrance preference, room space and fees. [G06]

Private guiding can address architecture/history, with a three-hour walk in one package. Match pace, language, route and weather. Children/extra-bed rules do not prove childcare or a kids' programme. [G06, G09, G12]

## 7. Packages, extras and price conditions

| Arrangement | Building blocks | Price / conditions |
|---|---|---|
| Discover Your Prague | Breakfast, one tasting dinner for two with water/coffee, return airport/train transfers, one three-hour walk | Quote; minimum two nights; published five-day cancellation condition [G12] |
| Romantic Prague | Breakfast, tasting dinner, transfers, once-per-stay wine/strawberries/rose/candle/aromatic bath | Quote; minimum two nights [G13] |
| Timeless Celebration | Breakfast, tasting dinner for two, pralines | Quote; minimum one night [G14] |
| Crown of the Golden Well | Rudolf II suite, private gazebo dining and special wine/champagne/service | Quote; minimum one night; seven-day cancellation condition; garden feasibility [G15] |
| Room delivery of ordinary breakfast | Breakfast moved to room | CZK 200 delivery only; food inclusion depends on rate [G07] |
| Emperor breakfast for two | Champagne, caviar/salmon, eggs/toast | CZK 5,900 appears under “delivery fee”: total versus extra charge unresolved [G07] |

Never invent a new package price by adding/subtracting these components, or apply package cancellation conditions to unrelated bookings.

## 8. Composition possibilities — proposals for staff

| Volunteered guest cue | Known resources | Possible composition | Owner and checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Avoids feather pillows, values sleep | Bedding menu [G02] | Appropriate non-down setup and agreed turndown timing | Reception + housekeeping: fill, firmness, stock, allergy process; no clinical guarantee |
| Anniversary without alcohol or public fuss | Alcohol-free pairing/sparkling, pralines, turndown [G06, G10, G11, G14] | Discreet praline and alcohol-free attention instead of wine/petals | Reception + restaurant: substitution permission, delivery, cost, consent |
| Architecture interest but low walking stamina | Tailored guide, lounge, room breakfast [G06–G08, G12] | Shorter/slower walk with a break and unhurried breakfast | Reception: route, demands, language, availability, revised price |
| Enjoys food but dislikes long dinners | Restaurant expertise [G10] | Ask about a shorter seasonal sequence | Restaurant: service constraints, diet and quote; shorter menu not published |
| Wants relaxation without scent | Bath and in-room massage [G06] | Unscented treatment or simple bath preparation | Reception + therapist + housekeeping: products, suitability, room/bath, timing and fee |

Packages demonstrate coordinated resources, not unlimited permission to recombine them. Other evidence-based compositions remain possible.

## 9. Conversation and brief handoff

Explore relevant sleep comfort, walking pace, food and degree of ceremony without a feature questionnaire. Experiences go to the confirmed concierge/reception; bedding/bath setup through reception to housekeeping; food to restaurant. Each suggestion links a volunteered cue, evidence, proposed adjustment and outstanding checks. A refusal of personalisation overrides every example.

## 10. Review queue and evidence conflicts

Obtain actual pillow menu, room-specific access/bath/connecting options, breakfast/à-la-carte menus, therapist/bath tariffs and dietary controls. Resolve Emperor breakfast wording and extra-bed billing unit. Confirm garden access and current chef/menu. Restaurant tabs did not reliably expose current breakfast/à-la-carte documents, so missing details were not inferred. No availability check or hotel contact was made.

## 11. Source register

All read on 2026-10-05; public property or restaurant material.

messages.content: Hello Nora! I'd love to get to know you a little before your stay at Golden Well / U Zlate Studne, so the team can think about the details that matter to you. This chat is optional; you can skip a question or finish whenever you like. What brings you here this time?
Ben and I are celebrating eight years together, and it's our first time in Prague.
Eight years together and a first visit to Prague make this a special trip. What are you most looking forward to discovering together, and have you already made any plans?
Nothing booked. We want one nice dinner and slow wandering. I love architecture and old staircases; Ben likes jazz and little bookshops.

Slow wandering sounds like a lovely way to meet Prague, with plenty to catch both your eyes and Ben’s. For your dinner, what kinds of food or flavours do you both enjoy—and what do you like to drink with it?
We both like fish, roast vegetables and lemon desserts. I usually drink sparkling water; Ben sometimes has red wine. Nothing too drawn-out or formal.

Fish, roast vegetables and lemon desserts sound like a lovely fit for an unhurried dinner; I’ll keep Nora’s sparkling water and Ben’s occasional red wine distinct. Do either of you have any food allergies or dietary restrictions the restaurant should know about?
Neither of us has allergies or dietary restrictions.

Good to know neither of you has any restrictions. After a slow day of wandering, do you tend to reach for a favourite sweet or savoury treat—or is there a particular snack you’d both enjoy finding in your room?
I love dried apricots; Ben loves dark chocolate. Different stashes!

output.reply: Different stashes indeed. When you’re away from home, is there anything that helps you sleep comfortably, or a bedtime habit you like to keep?
